ai_review.summary: Soulful, flawless performance with standout Brown‑Eyed Women, Beat It On Down the Line, and The Race Is On; recording source unknown but presumably adequate.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this concert as one of the best setlists ever, praising soulful playing and flawless execution of songs like Brown‑Eyed Women, Beat It On Down the Line, The Race Is On, and Row Jimmy. No specific comments on the audio were provided, so the recording quality cannot be assessed from these reviews.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are uniformly five‑star and focus on an exceptional musical performance; lacking recording details, a moderate assumption is made for audio quality, yielding a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No reviewers mentioned sound clarity, mix, or source type.

standout_songs: Beat It On Down the Line
show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as one of the best setlists ever with consistently soulful and flawless performances throughout.
